gold: Kaposiform hemangioendothelioma (KHE) of the internal auditory canal

selector.rationale: Both Hemangioma and Lymphangioma have similar evidence support, but the presence of a vascular lesion with low mitotic activity and positive CD34 and CD31 staining for endothelial cells slightly favors Hemangioma.

rejected.label: Lymphangioma
rejected.why: Although the pattern is similar to lymphangiomatosis, the vascular nature and specific staining patterns are more indicative of Hemangioma.
